subject: Mathematics

definitions.definition: An algebraic expression consisting of variables and coefficients with non-negative integer exponents, e.g., p(x) = 3x² + 2x + 1.
A value of x for which p(x) = 0. Also called roots of the polynomial.
The highest power of the variable in the polynomial.
A polynomial with exactly one term.
A polynomial with exactly two terms.
A polynomial with exactly three terms.

formulae.name: Remainder Theorem
formulae.formula: When p(x) is divided by (x - a), the remainder = p(a)

formulae.name: Factor Theorem
formulae.formula: (x - a) is a factor of p(x) if and only if p(a) = 0
formulae.used_for: Checking whether a given expression is a factor of polynomial

important_concepts: A polynomial of degree n has at most n zeros
Every linear polynomial has exactly one zero
A non-zero constant polynomial has no zeros
Zero polynomial (0) has every real number as its zero
Sum of zeros of ax² + bx + c = -b/a
Product of zeros of ax² + bx + c = c/a
common_mistakes: Confusing degree of polynomial with number of terms
Applying remainder theorem incorrectly (substituting wrong value)
Forgetting that √x is not a polynomial
